sentence_stem: Although the manager had promised a bonus,
correct_completion: the staff received no bonus this year.
full_sentence: Although the manager had promised a bonus, the staff received no bonus this year.
acceptable_variants: the staff did not get any bonus in the end.
the employees were still left without a bonus.

options.text: so the staff celebrated in the office.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result that follows naturally. 'Although' requires an outcome that contrasts with the promise, so a celebration does not fit.

options.text: the staff had worked overtime for months.
options.why_wrong: This adds background information about the work, but it does not complete the contrast that 'although' introduces.

options.text: the office was repainted in blue.
options.why_wrong: This describes an unrelated event and does not provide the contrasting outcome expected after 'although'.

options.text: the staff received no bonus this year.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must present an outcome that contrasts with the first part of the sentence. Learners sometimes choose a clause that gives a result or adds background detail, which breaks the contrast. The correct option shows that the promise was not kept.
translation: Embora o gerente tivesse prometido um bônus, os funcionários não receberam nenhum bônus este ano.
